body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sennheiser showcased its Adidas performance headphone 'CX 680' at CES 2010, featuring in-ear speaker with 'EarFin' holding system. It is including volume control and deluxe accessory kit.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
